stem_book: In the Vn-method of summing a series whose terms are products of factors in A.P., the denominator is: (a) Difference (b) Product of all general terms (c) First term (d) Sum of last two terms
key: b Product of all general terms
derived: b Product of all general terms
correct_answer: b Product of all general terms
reason: Print says 'in this series method' - named the Vn-method in the stem so it stands alone.
work: Tn = (last − first)/(t1·t2·…·tn) → denominator = product of all the factors
